items: Android 14 and later: setup now takes one step. Controller sticks and triggers work without the Gamepad Pro keyboard.
Don't need the Gamepad Pro keyboard anymore? A one-time tip shows you how to turn it off, so your usual keyboard stays put.
Fixed a crash when turning on the service in landscape.
Stability improvements.
New setting: "Trigger sensitivity (LT/RT)".
New setting: "Pass unmapped controls to games", great for cloud gaming.
"Default mapping options" is back in Settings.
Right stick now works on more third-party controllers.
Fixed held LT/RT, buttons pressed together, and stuck touches when using many buttons.
Fixed a stylus seen as a controller, the floating button not coming back, and occasional freezes.
Fixed the mapping service crashing mid-game and leaving buttons dead until re-enabled.
Fixed "hold" toggle actions stopping after the first press.
Android 10 and below: tapping a chat box in a game now opens your regular keyboard.
Mappings now start with just an external keyboard, no controller needed.
Fixed crashes on controller disconnect and when dialogs open after returning from the background.
Location permission removed.
Tablets, foldables and split screen: the keymap editor and test screen are no longer locked to one orientation.
Six more FAQ answers now have a demo video.
Edge-to-edge layout: the intro and privacy policy screens are no longer covered by the system bars.
Editor backgrounds now decode at screen size, using far less memory and keeping dragging smooth.
Fixed mappings going dead after an hour or two of play: sticks and triggers only came back after restarting the service.
Fixed held buttons all firing again every few seconds mid-game until the accessibility service was turned off.
Saving a layout with sticks or triggers no longer interrupts you with keyboard setup.
FAQ & Help: video tutorials in the answers, plus four new questions.
Fixed swapped LB/RB and LT/RT labels on the controller test screen.
